sentences.en: We will explore every planet that goes around the sun.
sentences.zh: 我们将探索围绕太阳运转的所有行星。

sentences.en: This chapter will focus on the riddles of the planets.
sentences.zh: 本章将重点探讨行星之谜。

sentences.en: Nine planets including the earth are moving around the sun.
sentences.zh: 包括地球在内的九颗行星正在绕着太阳运行。

phrases.zh: 在地球上（泛指整个星球）

senses.zh: 行星；地球（the planet）；<史>命运星辰
